title: Mailboxes
intro: Mailboxes the platform reads for your sessions: a session of a workgroup you release a mailbox to finds mails in it on a platform device, without seeing its password. Nothing is released by default.
load-failed: The mailboxes could not be loaded: {reason}
name: Name
name.hint: Lower-case letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen; sessions name the mailbox by it.
name.taken: You already have a mailbox with this name.
imap_password.keep: IMAP password (empty: keep the stored one)
release.label: Workgroups whose sessions may read this mailbox
release.none: You have explicit access to no workgroup.
check.starting: Sending the check to the device…
check.read-failed: Waiting for the device (the last read failed: {reason})
check.valid: The device signed in to the mailbox.
check.invalid: The device could not sign in to the mailbox.
remove.confirm: Delete this mailbox? Sessions can no longer read it.
